snippet.title: [Crusaders Quest : Hero Town] Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Launch on 3/31 Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4126220?utm_source=video&utm_medium=Youtube&utm_campaign=CQHT_YT

Welcome to 'Crusader Quest: Hero Town'!
A little town inside your PC!
Gather heroes and rebuild the town in 'Crusader Quest: Hero Town', a desktop idle RPG that can be enjoyed even during work hours.
